image_description: A medium shot of two people in a boat holding a large fish. The person in the foreground is wearing sunglasses and a beige jacket, smiling at the camera. Behind them, another person in a cap looks on. They are holding a large, silver-grey fish horizontally across their laps. The background shows a river or lake with a tree-lined shore under a bright sky.

The anatomical details of the head are muddy and indistinct. Key features like barbels are missing, and the mouth line is ambiguous, suggesting a failure to render complex biological structures.
